title: Closed support of proper pushforward
statement: Let Z be Noetherian, q : Y → Z proper, and F coherent on Y. The support of q_*F is a closed subset of Z.

source.place: Theorem 088E, support of H paragraph; Tag 02O5 and Lemma 056J

proof.text: A proper morphism to the Noetherian target has locally Noetherian source. Coherence provides finite local generators whose kernels are finite type. Reindex each finite generating family by ULift (Fin n), apply the coherent-kernel condition and the generators-kernel presentation construction, and descend finite presentation along the covering. The coherent/quasi-coherent finite-type equivalence supplies quasi-coherence.

Apply the finite-presentation and quasi-coherence theorems for the zeroth higher direct image. The canonical rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf isomorphism identifies it with the ordinary pushforward; transport both properties along this isomorphism. Finite presentation implies finite type. The finite-type support theorem gives the closed set of points with nonsubsingleton stalk, which supplies D.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pushforward_support_closed
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (F : CoherentModules Y) :
    ∃ D : TopologicalSpace.Closeds Z,
      (D : Set Z) =
        {x : Z | ¬ Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj).presheaf.stalk x)}
